verdicts.reason: A keeps the product on its circle and stacks it above the copy, but the alignment is mixed: GROVE is centred, the headline and body are left-aligned, and the badges and CTA are pushed right. The badge row almost touches the right edge and there is little room at the bottom. B cuts the circle away from the product so the headline and buttons sit on it while the shoe floats below. It also leaves 'back' as an orphan word on its own line, has tiny body text, and sends the FREE DELIVERY badge to an empty bottom-left corner.
